playstyle.identity: Vayne is a tank-killing ADC with true damage on every third hit. Her tumble and invisibility make her slippery while she melts anyone regardless of armor.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives movement speed toward enemies. Q tumbles and empowers auto. W deals true damage every third hit (percent max health). E pushes enemy back, stunning if they hit terrain. R gives AD and makes Q grant invisibility. Kite with Q tumbles, W shreds tanks.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vayne spikes with attack speed items. Kraken and Guinsoo's maximize her DPS. She's a late-game hypercarry.

passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.summary: Gain movement speed when moving toward enemy champions.
passive.details: Vayne gains bonus movement speed when moving toward a visible enemy champion.

abilities.name: Tumble
abilities.summary: Roll and empower next auto to deal bonus damage.
abilities.details: Vayne tumbles a short distance and empowers her next basic attack to deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Silver Bolts
abilities.summary: Every third attack on the same target deals true damage.
abilities.details: Vayne's attacks apply silver bolts. On the third attack against the same target, the bolts detonate dealing percent max health true damage.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.summary: Knock back an enemy; stun if they hit terrain.
abilities.details: Vayne fires a heavy bolt that knocks back an enemy. If they hit terrain, they're stunned and take bonus damage.

abilities.name: Final Hour
abilities.summary: Gain AD and bonus passive speed; Tumble grants invisibility.
abilities.details: Vayne gains bonus attack damage and triple the movement speed from Night Hunter. Tumble also grants brief invisibility.
